Home Loans
NerdWallet is not a lender. NerdWallet may receive compensation from its advertising financial services and lending partners. Terms, rates, and conditions vary by lender. Get an official loan estimate before choosing a loan.

Refinancing
The amount you save on a refinanced mortgage may vary by loan. If you extend your loan term, you may pay more interest over the life of your loan.

Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC)
A HELOC is an open-end loan secured by your home. Failure to repay may result in foreclosure. Terms, rates, and conditions vary by lender.
